titles.romaji: Kenja Time no Sukkiri Hitozuma Bouken-ki!
titles.native: 賢者タイムのスッキリ人妻冒険記

description:
Based on the erotic doujin game by RPG Nukuuru Koubou (RPGヌクール工房).

A dungeon suddenly appeared in a small, remote village. If the monsters within were to escape, the village would be destroyed. Just as the villagers were sinking into despair, an adventurer arrived—a sage named Time, an expert in magic.

"Please, Sage! You must protect our village!"

However, this was a "pink dungeon"—a place inhabited exclusively by female-type monsters. For Time, the sage, this was the worst possible scenario: becoming sexually aroused would cause his powers to weaken. Though he felt terrible about it, he tried to decline... but the married women of the village stepped forward, offering to help manage his sexual urges so he could clear the dungeon! Devoting themselves to the cause of saving their village, these married women reveal the full extent of their charms. Their service only escalates, eventually crossing the line...

A sage who grows weaker the moment he becomes aroused—now heading into a "pink dungeon," a den of female-type monsters!? The key to saving the village lies in the ultimate, boundary-pushing support provided by these married women!

(Source: Getchu, translated)
